   This RFC is an official specification for the Internet community.

RFC1122                       INTRODUCTION                  October 1989


1.  INTRODUCTION

   This document is one of a pair that defines host requirements.

   1.1  The Internet Architecture

      A host computer is any computer attached to the network.

      1.1.1  Internet Hosts

         A host must follow these rules:

         1.  Send datagrams.

         2.  Receive datagrams.

         The rules above are complete.

2.  TRANSPORT PROTOCOLS

   This section covers transport.

   2.2  TRANSMISSION CONTROL PROTOCOL

         2.2.2.8  TCP Connection State Diagram: RFC-793 Section 3.2,
            page 23

            There are several problems with this diagram.

Security Considerations

   There are many security issues in the communication layers.
